RESULTS Well 30/9-18 was spudded on 14th March 1995 and reached total depth at 2994m on 6th April 1995 in the Drake Formation. The well was plugged back and permanently abandoned, and the well was completed on 11th April 1995. The well penetrated the Brent Group reservoir zones. The reservoir zones were water bearing.
